SkinKit 1.0.0 — engineering license draft, 2026-10-11
Licensor: individual developer; legal name pending before store publication.

The demo App is distributed by a one-time paid download. A lawful purchase
includes extraction and commercial use of the binary SDK and documentation,
and future updates of the SkinKit App, SDK and interface documentation without
an additional export charge or in-app purchase. No support SLA is promised.

SkinKit-owned bundled artwork and example materials may be integrated into
commercial host applications and distributed as part of those applications.
The artwork and example materials themselves may not be sold separately or
redistributed for a separate fee, or used to build similar theme packs for
commercial sale. Ordinary commercial host applications and their integration
or adaptation wrappers remain permitted; this restriction is not a general
prohibition on theme libraries or SDKs.
These restrictions do not override rights already granted by a third-party
license, including existing CC0 and Apache-2.0 materials. The original notices,
license texts and dependency inventory remain applicable. Generated artwork
is not represented as exclusive or guaranteed to support exclusive rights.

This engineering draft records the project owner's approved commercial scope.
It has not been represented as an external legal review. Production store
identity, store terms and production signing remain separate publication gates.
The binary package contains host integration examples, not SDK implementation
source. Binary delivery and paid store acquisition are not a DRM guarantee.
